37:     buckets.set(bucket, (buckets.get(bucket) ?? 0) + 1);

3:   previous?: Link<K>;

6: export class RecencyList<K> {
7:   head?: Link<K>;
8:   tail?: Link<K>;
9:   length = 0;
10:   prepend(key: K) {
11:     const link: Link<K> = { key, next: this.head };
12:     if (this.head) this.head.previous = link;
13:     else this.tail = link;
14:     this.head = link;
15:     this.length += 1;
16:     return link;
17:   }
18:   remove(link: Link<K>) {
19:     if (link.previous) link.previous.next = link.next;
20:     else this.head = link.next;
21:     if (link.next) link.next.previous = link.previous;
22:     else this.tail = link.previous;
23:     link.next = undefined;
24:     link.previous = undefined;
25:     this.length -= 1;
26:   }
27:   promote(link: Link<K>) {
28:     if (link === this.head) return;
29:     this.remove(link);
30:     link.next = this.head;
31:     if (this.head) this.head.previous = link;
32:     else this.tail = link;
33:     this.head = link;
34:     this.length += 1;
35:   }

46:     for (let cursor = this.head; cursor; cursor = cursor.next) {
47:       if (cursor.previous !== previous) throw new Error('broken previous link');
